stances.quote: Carter secures $346.1 million for GA-01 in House-passed defense bill WASHINGTON, D.C. – Rep. Earl L. “Buddy” Carter (R-GA) today secured $346.1 million for Georgia’s First Congressional District in the House-passed National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA)
stances.reasoning: Text explicitly highlights securing substantial defense funding and representing major military installations as priorities.

stances.quote: As a Member of Congress, I have voted to cut more than $5 trillion in waste from the federal budget which reaches balance and begins paying off the national debt within ten years without raising taxes.
stances.reasoning: Explicit statement opposing tax increases while cutting spending to balance the budget.

stances.quote: I will continue to fight to end Washington’s out of control spending addiction.
stances.reasoning: Multiple statements emphasize cutting trillions in waste and balancing the budget by reducing spending.
No statements address trade policy, tariffs, or free trade.
No statements address foreign aid spending.
